class.name: CppScript
class.brief_description: A native C++ script source file.
class.description: A native C++ script source file saved with the [code].cpp[/code] extension. C++ scripts are compiled code: the editor can create, save, inspect, and attach them as placeholder script resources, but they do not execute from source text at runtime. To make a C++ class run in a project, compile and register it as an engine module or GDExtension class, then use the compiled native type.
